app.name: Project Write
start.tagline: Write, organise, connect – local and private.
start.checks.title: System check
error.database: The data storage did not respond.
error.schemaTooNew: This data comes from a newer version of Project Write. Please update the app.
library.title: Library
library.intro: A library is a folder in which Project Write keeps your documents and media. It stays on this device.
library.journal.rollback: Rollback journal (for sync folders and network drives)
library.notes.migrated: The database was updated from schema {from}. A backup is in the library at {backup}.
library.notes.orphaned: Found {count} files without a database entry. They were not deleted.
library.warning.syncFolder.title: Sync folder detected
library.warning.networkDrive.title: Network drive detected
library.warning.syncFolder: This location is in a folder that {provider} synchronises. Sync clients copy files one by one and can damage a database while doing so. A local location is recommended.
library.warning.networkDrive: This location is on a network drive. Interrupted connections can damage a database. A local location is recommended.
library.warning.rollback: If you use it anyway, the database works in rollback mode there.
library.warning.inUse: The library lies at such a location. Project Write uses rollback mode there.
library.moved.title: Library was moved
library.moved.text: This library was moved to {path}. Changes to this old copy will be missing from the new one.
library.moved.done: Move complete. The old folder stays until you remove it: {path}
library.dialog.create: Choose a location for the new library
library.dialog.move: Choose a new location for the library
library.choice.isLibrary: This folder already contains a library.
library.moving.title: Moving the library
library.settings.damaged: The app settings were damaged and have been reset. The old file was kept.
library.settings.newerVersion: The app settings come from a newer version and are not changed.
library.settings.notSaved: The library location could not be saved. You will need to choose it again at the next start.
error.fileSystem: A file could not be read or written.
error.libraryNotFound: No library was found in this folder.
error.libraryInvalid: The library file library.json is damaged.
error.libraryTooNew: This library comes from a newer version of Project Write. Please update the app.
error.libraryLocked: This library is already open in another instance of Project Write.
error.libraryLockUnsupported: At this location the library cannot be protected against being opened twice. Please choose another location.
error.libraryMoved: This library was moved to another location.
error.libraryUnsafePath: The library contains a link or an invalid name ({path}). For safety it is not opened.
error.libraryDatabaseDamaged: The library database is damaged. Nothing was changed.
error.libraryBackupFailed: No backup could be made before updating the database. Nothing was changed.
error.folderNotEmpty: The folder contains other files. Please choose an empty folder.
error.folderIsLibrary: This folder already contains a library.
error.locationNotAccepted: This location has to be confirmed first.
error.locationExpired: The chosen location is no longer known. Please choose it again.
error.pathNotUnicode: The path contains characters Project Write cannot handle.
error.moveCancelled: The move was cancelled. The library is unchanged.
error.moveTargetInvalid: The target lies inside the library or contains it.
error.moveVerificationFailed: A copied file differs from the original. The move was not completed; the library is unchanged.
error.moveSwitchFailed: The moved library could not be opened. The previous library stays in use.
